status: Settings fixed before extension target scoring; not a registered preregistration
purpose: quantify an optimistic acquisition feasibility bound

representation_control.source_boundaries: CIC: first 60% completion-ordered flows as historical source pool; fixed physical cutoff shared by representations. UNSW: existing January/February time boundaries.

independent_validation.source_pool: first 60% completion-ordered flows; same physical cutoff for all representations
independent_validation.source_fit_validation: 70/30 stratified split inside historical pool; disjoint selection/calibration
independent_validation.capture_scope: two base stations in one testbed; not two independent sites
independent_validation.original_argus_times: Re-extract epoch times from the original Argus flow records; spreadsheet mm:ss fields are ineligible. Require exact Seq alignment with released labels.
independent_validation.additional_capture: NF-BoT-IoT-v3, one independent capture lineage, all six representations and HGB/XGBoost; identical 60% source-pool split and resource settings.

exclusions: No trusted timestamp, missing source class, missing calibration negatives, or missing target class is retained as an explicit unsupported condition. No alternative split is selected from target performance.
reporting: All configurations retained, including failures. Equal weighting by scenario then scorer and fit; query repetitions do not create independent captures. Percentile ranges over query schedules are descriptive conditional ranges, not population confidence intervals.
metadata_amendment: Before any extension target replay: reject HIKARI without timestamps; require original Argus epoch timestamps for 5G-NIDD; add timestamped NF-BoT-IoT-v3; specify issued-decision feedback as the extension default. Source-model selection settings unchanged.
